name: planeswalker_that_returns_is_a_new_object_for_the_loyalty_limit
notes: Bug hunt 2026-11-17 (hunt 3 F3, hunt 2 H2-4). Basri Ket's +1 is activated, then Basri returns to hand and enters again the same turn (Barrin's enter trigger, or any bounce and recast). CR 400.7, 606.3: the returned Basri is a new permanent, and no loyalty ability of it has been activated this turn, so its +1 can be activated again (3 + 1 = 4 loyalty). Failed before the fix: the once-per-turn clock (Executor.loyalty_clock) was keyed on the card's handle, which is stable across zones, and never cleared when it left the battlefield ('window:loyalty:once_per_turn').
